bio: Spend a relaxing afternoon indulging in the great British tradition at East Sussex National Resort. Enjoy a delicious Afternoon Tea at this elegant venue that has two championship golf courses on site.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Sussex Lounge or on the terrace which provides an ideal hideaway for diners to unwind and savour their meal.  The menu consists of quintessential hallmarks of the Afternoon Tea ritual such as finger sandwiches served on white and brown bloomer bread, along with a whole range of tasty sweet treats. A Vegan Afternoon Tea menu is also available.  The East Sussex National Resort is located in Little Horsted, and diners can experience the picturesque views provided by this peaceful countryside hotel.
